offset_convention: Zero-based half-open byte ranges; one-based inclusive line ranges. Newline counts are unchanged.
distribution_SHA256SUMS: SHA256SUMS is regenerated and covers all distribution files except itself; this prevents recursive hash dependency.
redaction_scope: Only cloud workspace root, pytest temporary root and cloud hostname; XML placeholders are escaped. No failure, testcase, test count, product source, patch or reviewed source identity changed.
